Alex Chen: Quick follow-up from the regional failover postmortem. Need owners + timelines so we can run a validation game day. I'll propose owners; please ack or reassign.

Priya Nair: I'll own customer comms & internal summary. Adding FAQ to the shared sheet (link will be in the epic). ETA: 3 business days.

Mateo Ruiz: I'll take routing test harness (canary + failback). Deliverables: test scripts + CI job. ETA: 8 business days. Need a test cluster.

Kira Owens: I'll update the restore runbook with PITR steps and post-restore checks. Drafting in `docs/runbooks/restore.md`. ETA: 4 business days.

Daniel Ho: Taking cache-drain hook and pre-failover sync. Plan: implement `kv-drain` step in routing orchestration. ETA: 3 days.

Samir Patel: Router policy change + telemetry PR - will open MR and add feature flag. PR will reference the epic. ETA: 48 hours.

ops-bot: Epic created: INFRA-8120 (regional failover closure). Link: https://jira.redwood/browse/INFRA-8120. Tag PRs/docs with INFRA-8120.

Alex Chen: Consolidated actions: Mateo (routing tests, 8d), Kira (runbook, 4d), Daniel (kv-drain, 3d), Samir (policy PR, 2d), Priya (comms, 3d). Game day: propose Wed 2026-04-13 09:00 PT. Please ack.

Priya Nair: :white_check_mark:
Mateo Ruiz: :white_check_mark: (will request infra-test-5 access)
Kira Owens: :white_check_mark:
Daniel Ho: :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: :white_check_mark:

Alex Chen: Great. I'll schedule the first weekly 30-min triage for progress. Update the Jira epic as you make progress. If any ETA slips, post here so we can reassign.

Priya Nair: Noted. Looping legal for FAQ review.

Mateo Ruiz: Requesting infra-test-5 access to run latency-steering experiments. @Samir Patel please grant when convenient.

Samir Patel: Will add access and post the quick commands.

Alex Chen: Closing initial triage. Thanks all. :rocket:
